subject: HIN
label: Grade 07
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 07 Hindi, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 4 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: Prose reading
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Prose reading', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: read and summarise. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Prose reading' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: read and summarise, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: गद्यांश पढ़ें; मुख्य भाव एक वाक्य में लिखें; प्रश्नों के उत्तर गद्यांश के शब्दों में दें; एक उचित शीर्षक सुझाएँ। Method: Model run for 'Prose reading'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Read and summarise: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Read the passage I wrote. हमारे स्कूल के पीछे एक छोटा-सा बगीचा है। हर सप्ताह सातवीं कक्षा के विद्यार्थी वहाँ पौधों को पानी देते हैं और सूखे पत्ते हटाते हैं। [Behind our school there is a small garden. Every week seventh-grade students water the plants there and remove dry leaves.]

Step 2, Read the rest. पिछले महीने लगाए गए टमाटर अब पकने लगे हैं। इस काम से विद्यार्थियों ने मेहनत और ज़िम्मेदारी का महत्त्व सीखा। [Tomatoes planted last month have now started ripening. Through this work the students learned the value of hard work and responsibility.]

Step 3, Find the main idea and key points. Main idea: बगीचे की देखभाल से बच्चे ज़िम्मेदारी सीखते हैं [Caring for the garden teaches children responsibility]. Key points: पानी देना, पत्ते हटाना, टमाटर पकना. Mark these in the passage.

Step 4, Write a summary. स्कूल के बगीचे की देखभाल सातवीं कक्षा के विद्यार्थी करते हैं। टमाटर पकने लगे हैं और बच्चों ने मेहनत व ज़िम्मेदारी सीखी। [Seventh-grade students look after the school garden. The tomatoes are ripening and the children learned hard work and responsibility.]

Step 5, Fix an error. A student writes a summary as long as the passage and adds मुझे बगीचा बहुत अच्छा लगता है [I like the garden very much]. Correction: a summary is about one third as long, in your own words, with no opinion.

Step 6, Your turn: answer what the students do every week and what they learned. Model answer: विद्यार्थी हर सप्ताह पौधों को पानी देते हैं और सूखे पत्ते हटाते हैं। उन्होंने मेहनत और ज़िम्मेदारी का महत्त्व सीखा। [Students water the plants and remove dry leaves every week. They learned the value of hard work and responsibility.]

modules.title: Grammar: case, sandhi, and sentence parts
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Grammar: case, sandhi, and sentence parts', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: use these in sentences. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Grammar: case, sandhi, and sentence parts' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: use these in sentences, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: संधि: विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय; सूर्य + उदय = सूर्योदय। कारक: 'राम ने फल खाया' में 'ने' कर्ता कारक का चिह्न है। Method: Model run for 'Grammar: case, sandhi, and sentence parts'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Use these in sentences: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Case (कारक) shows the role of a noun using small words: ने, को, से, के लिए, का/की/के, में, पर. Examples: राम ने आम खाया। [Ram ate a mango.] माँ ने बच्चे को दूध दिया। [Mother gave milk to the child.] मैं पेंसिल से लिखता हूँ। [I write with a pencil.]

Step 2, More cases. पेड़ से पत्ता गिरा। [A leaf fell from the tree.] सीता का भाई स्कूल में है। [Seeta's brother is in school.] मेज़ पर किताब है। [There is a book on the table.] Name each word and its role: का shows relation, में shows place.

Step 3, Learn sandhi (joining of sounds). विद्या + आलय = विद्यालय [school], पुस्तक + आलय = पुस्तकालय [library], सूर्य + उदय = सूर्योदय [sunrise], महा + उत्सव = महोत्सव [grand festival]. Say each pair, then the joined word.

Step 4, A consonant sandhi: सत् + जन = सज्जन [good person], उत् + नति = उन्नति [progress]. Break the word the other way too: विद्यालय = विद्या + आलय. Then find parts of a sentence: राम (doer) आम (object) खाता है (action).

Step 5, Fix an error. A student writes मोहन ने रोटी खाया। Correction: मोहन ने रोटी खाई। because with ने the verb agrees with the object रोटी, which is feminine. Also write पुस्तक + आलय as पुस्तकालय, not पुस्तकआलय.

Step 6, Your turn: write a sentence with ने and का, then join देव + आलय. Model answer: सीता ने भाई का बस्ता उठाया। देव + आलय = देवालय [temple]. [Seeta lifted her brother's bag.] Check ने with the past verb.

modules.title: Poetry
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Poetry', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: read and explain. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Poetry' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: read and explain, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: कविता की पंक्तियों में तुक खोजें (जैसे आम और शाम), कवि का भाव बताएँ और भावार्थ अपने शब्दों में लिखें। Method: Model run for 'Poetry'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Read and explain: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Read the lines I wrote. दीपक जला है अँधेरी रात में, कहता है जग से, मैं अकेला नहीं हूँ। हर किरण मेरी दूसरों की राह है, जो बाँटता है उजाला, वही महान है। [A lamp burns in the dark night, saying, I am not alone. Each ray is another's path; one who shares light is great.]

Step 2, Understand the words. दीपक [lamp], जग [world], किरण [ray], राह [path], उजाला [light], महान [great]. Write each meaning and read again. Notice the poem has no strict rhyme, so it is read by its meaning and rhythm.

Step 3, Find the symbols. The lamp stands for a helpful person; the dark night stands for difficulty or ignorance; light stands for kindness and knowledge. Write: दीपक उस व्यक्ति का प्रतीक है जो दूसरों की मदद करता है। [The lamp is a symbol of a person who helps others.]

Step 4, Explain the message. कवि कहता है कि सच्ची महानता अपना सुख बाँटने में है। [The poet says true greatness lies in sharing one's happiness.] Point to the last line as the key line. Identify personification: the lamp speaks like a person.

Step 5, Fix an error. A student explains only that a lamp burns at night. Correction: that is the literal meaning; add the deeper meaning: the lamp shows a person who gives help, so the poem is about sharing and kindness.

Step 6, Your turn: say what the dark night stands for and what the poem teaches. Model answer: अँधेरी रात मुश्किल समय का प्रतीक है। कविता सिखाती है कि हमें दूसरों के जीवन में उजाला बाँटना चाहिए। [The dark night stands for a difficult time. The poem teaches that we should share light in the lives of others.]

modules.title: Letters and applications
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Letters and applications', taught in a way that is with notes, a worked line and a self-mark. The target is clear: write formal letters. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: Listen first: your teacher or a recording says the new words or sentences from 'Letters and applications' twice. You repeat them aloud.
Notice the pattern: find where the new sound, word form or sentence rule appears in a short text and mark it.
Use it: write formal letters, first with help, then alone.
Check and fix: read your work aloud once more; fix one thing you hear is wrong.
modules.example: Solved: अनौपचारिक पत्र: दिनांक, संबोधन (प्रिय मित्र रवि), कुशल-क्षेम, मुख्य बात, समापन (तुम्हारा मित्र, अमन)। औपचारिक: सेवा में, प्रधानाचार्य महोदय; विषय: अवकाश हेतु प्रार्थना-पत्र; मुख्य भाग दो छोटे अनुच्छेदों में; आपका आज्ञाकारी शिष्य, नाम, कक्षा। Method: Model run for 'Letters and applications'. Teacher text (3 lines about a daily activity). Step 1, read it aloud together. Step 2, mark every word or sentence that uses the new pattern. Step 3, a learner writes or says two new lines of their own that use the same pattern. Step 4, the learner reads them aloud and corrects one slip. What a good answer looks like: the pattern is used correctly in both lines, the lines make sense, and the learner can say which part is the pattern.
modules.activity: About 30 to 40 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: a worked task and a corrected copy.
modules.standard: Write formal letters: at least 8 of 10 marks on a short task, with one line of reasoning for each answer.
steps: Step 1, Learn the layout of a formal application. Start with सेवा में [To], then प्रधानाचार्य महोदय [The Principal, Sir], then the school and town. Next comes the subject line, विषय:, and then the greeting महोदय [Sir]। Formal letters have no personal chatting, so stay brief and respectful.

Step 2, Write the subject line so the reader knows the point at once. विषय: तीन दिन के अवकाश हेतु प्रार्थना-पत्र [Subject: application for three days' leave]। Underline it. The subject line names the request in one phrase, never a full story.

Step 3, Write the body. सविनय निवेदन है कि मुझे तेज़ बुखार है, इसलिए मैं 12 नवंबर से 14 नवंबर 2026 तक विद्यालय नहीं आ सकूँगा [I humbly request that I have a high fever, so I cannot attend school from 12 to 14 November 2026]। That is three days, counting both dates.

Step 4, Close properly. अतः आपसे प्रार्थना है कि मुझे तीन दिन का अवकाश प्रदान करें [So I request you to grant me three days' leave]। आपका आज्ञाकारी शिष्य, अमित, कक्षा सात, दिनांक: 11 नवंबर 2026 [Your obedient student, Amit, class seven, dated 11 November 2026]।

Step 5, Compare a second formal letter, to an editor: सेवा में, संपादक महोदय, विषय: गली में कूड़े की समस्या [Subject: the problem of rubbish in our street]। Close with भवदीय [Yours faithfully]। Common errors: using तुम instead of आप, casual greetings, and a missing subject line.

Step 6, Your turn: write the subject line, body and closing for two days' leave, 20 to 21 November 2026, for a family function. Model answer: विषय: दो दिन के अवकाश हेतु प्रार्थना-पत्र। सविनय निवेदन है कि पारिवारिक समारोह के कारण मैं 20 और 21 नवंबर को नहीं आ सकूँगा। कृपया अवकाश दें। आपका शिष्य।
